== Published English Original Virtual Set 1 wording ==
The early slips prohibit playing Organized Attack and All Wings Report In. The remastered text says those cards are canceled. The pilot capacity, timing and destination of the Pride Of The Empire search, DS-61-2 condition, immunity threshold and printed ship values agree.
